entries.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
entries.subject_zh: 法律尽调工具，律师对照历史报告人工修订 rubric 与报告格式。
quotes: In working sessions, Ropes & Gray’s lawyers compared test outputs with human-authored diligence reports from completed deals,
then refined the rubric and report format based on what the drafts got right and where they fell short.
Ropes & Gray designed the tool with a consistent query and framework that mimics the exact steps their team would take, from initial reviews to summaries to higher-level reviews.
entries.rationale_zh: 这是最接近反馈修改提示的边界案例：正文确有测试输出、历史人工报告、rubric 和格式修订，但明确由律师在工作会话中实施。工具执行固定查询与框架，报告产物由律师复核。未建立自动修改自身 Harness 并持久复用的新机制，不能将人工开发迭代改写为自进化。

entries.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
entries.subject_zh: 分层失配监控系统、人工响应、历史事件重放、红队与召回评测。
quotes: We track recall at each threshold on a central dashboard and test how proposed changes to the monitoring system affect recall before deploying them.
We believe that some of Sol’s advantage comes from the fact that we optimized the monitoring prompt for it.
Responders review the evidence, examine the affected systems, and take action to contain the incident.
entries.rationale_zh: 正文展示监控代理、异步调查、人工响应及迭代评测，也明确提到一次针对模型优化监控提示。它没有交代系统如何自动提出、修改、验收并保留自身 Harness 的迭代机制；监控目标是广义模型失配与未授权行为，不是专项评估 Harness 演化。保留为安全治理及评测参考，不进入 Harness 发布范围。
entries.boundary_zh: other_direction 仅表示安全/评测主题归属，不声称已证明另一种递归自改进循环。提示优化的操作者、算法、迭代轮次与保留机制仍为 unknown；不能把监控覆盖 Harness 或自动暂停任务等同于 Harness 自我演化。

entries.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
entries.subject_zh: 由机构修订的模型行为规范及后续价值对齐训练说明。
quotes: OpenAI writes the Spec, sets boundaries, and trains models to respect them; developers direct applications within those boundaries; and users direct the model’s work subject to those constraints.
Alongside this Model Spec update, we’ve been exploring new training methods to help our models learn these core values and better understand and follow the Spec’s specific behavioral principles.
